problem: Raster and RAW cache getters did not recheck request cancellation after resident lookup or completed swap read before RAM publication and visible-pin transfer. The app checked cancellation after return, after cache membership/pin could already change.
fix: Check cancellation after resident clone and before publishing swap restore. Drop rejected restore without changing visible pin or RAM membership. Recheck cancellation before pressure eviction.
regressions: Deterministic cancellation at resident-return and post-stream/pre-publication boundaries. Swap callback count measured independently so cancellation hits final cache publication boundary. Assert old visible pin remains, restored output credit drops, and retry preserves raster float bits / RAW metadata and samples.
limitations: Cancellation checks narrow publication races; they are not an atomic transaction with external generation changes.
Deterministic tests cover cache API publication boundaries, not physical UI scheduling latency.
Real CR3 readback is one fixture and a 128x96 offscreen frame, not universal RAW or physical HDR qualification.
3D model cache publication requires separate audit.
